g.text: Single-server FCFS queue, service = 40 ms prefill + 5 ms x Uniform{16..256} tokens, Poisson arrivals,

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #475569

g.text: 100k requests per load with 10k warmup dropped, seed 17. The measured mean tracks Pollaczek-Khinchine

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #475569

g.text: at every load; the p99 must be measured. Right: the same server probed two ways - the closed-loop

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #475569

g.text: generator backs off exactly when the server congests, and its p99 is a small multiple of p50.
